title: Surface contention in bee status
action: bee status (and status --json) reads .bee/logs/contention.jsonl and reports recent LOCK_BUSY events, top contended lock names, and holder/waiter session pairs so a waiting session can answer 'why am I waiting'. Bounded tail-window read, silent when the log is absent. Regen inside this cell after the code change: node skills/bee-hive/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply.

truths: status stays fast: tail window, no full-file scan

trace.outcome: bee status/--json surfaces lock-contention telemetry from .bee/logs/contention.jsonl via a 64KB bounded tail-window read (readTranscriptTail), reporting busy_count/recent_busy/top_locks/worst_wait_ms; absent/no-busy log omits the key entirely
